info.description: Generated from docs/api/openapi.json by tools/export_api_docs.py. Local console only. A collection-level pre-request script adds the Origin header and the X-Demo-Session / X-CSRF-Token headers; the first request creates the session and stores both values. Run it in order. Bodies are empty skeletons, so most write routes answer a documented 422; for requests with real bodies use postman_run_collection.json.
